detail: Seeded 3 decided cards, 1 open card and a ghost (node.proposed then node.decided). `werk search` printed exactly 'd1  First decided', 'd2  Second decided', 'd3  Third decided'; no open card, no ghost. Test: cli-b-09-search.test.ts.
`werk search cache eviction` printed two lines: 'layout  decided  Cache layout' then 'timer  open  Eviction timer'. 'Cache size' and the removed card (node.removed) were absent.

Reading: no word 'sqlite' in Storage format's subtree words; the outside open card's body says it. `werk search sqlite` listed 'storage  decided  Storage format' (match via option why-not) and 'other  open  Other card'; `--under parent` and `--status decided` each printed only 'storage  decided  Storage format'.

Paused/stale/postponed cards built with depends_on to reopened (postponed/rejected) cards and a decided card reopened postponed; show headers confirmed 'paused', 'stale', 'postponed'. `werk find routing` printed routing then guards only; `werk find client` printed routing, theme, guards (no client, paused, stale, postponed card).
Two trees with decided tops and one open card each, plus 'Auth flow' decided then node.reopened rejected. `werk find` printed o1, o2 and auth, all with status open; no decided line.
`werk show root` printed one rollup line 'subtree: 4 cards, 1 open, 1 proto, 2 decided' (1+1+2=4).
`werk show par` printed '  <- refines         ch  Child  (3 cards, 2 open, 1 decided)' and the own line 'subtree: 4 cards, 2 open, 2 decided'.

Card with depends_on (why), option (alternative_to), excerpt.quoted excerpt and a ghost source (node.proposed + supported_by). show printed the depends_on line with 'why:', then after the links 'Options' with title and 'why not:', 'Say' with 'x:ex0  you: "we charge per seat"', and 'Ev' with 'srv  Pricing survey  proposed' and 'finding:'.
Card with an excerpt and a source and no option: show printed 'Say' and 'Ev' sections and no 'Options' text.
`werk show` with no id printed the root title 'The root title', 'subtree: 2 cards, 1 open, 1 decided', and '  <- refines         second  Second card  (1 card, 1 open)'.

`werk status x decided` exited 1 with only the 'kill criterion:' gap and the line 'or: werk kill x --revisit'; show still '[open]' and the log was unchanged. Ran the printed `werk kill x --revisit`, then status decided printed 'x: decided' and show '[decided]'.

Card alone with title+body (a decided 'base' card exists elsewhere). status decided exited 1 naming who, basis, option and kill criterion, each with its werk command; card stayed open. Ran each printed command with placeholders filled (edit --who you, link depends_on base, add x:opt0 option + link alternative_to, kill --revisit); status decided then succeeded and show said '[decided]'.

Under an open root, ghost g1 added via CLI with --who you, held depends_on to decided base, ghost option + alternative_to, kill; ghost g2 with --who me and kill only. status g1 decided -> 'g1: decided' and show '[decided]'; status g2 decided exited 1 with 'basis: no decided card is a basis of #g2' and 'werk link g2 <card> --type depends_on ...'; g2 stayed open.

Reading: `werk propose` has no way to drop an edge, so the amend that removes the depends_on edge was run as `werk unlink x base --type depends_on` on the decided card. It exited 1: 'refused: #x is decided, and after this change 1 fact is missing / basis: ... / werk link x <card> --type depends_on ...'; show output and log were byte-identical to before.

`werk propose x --ops` (elaborated first block to 'Short.', removed second) then `werk accept x --actor you` exited 0; show '[decided]' with body 'Short.'; the log gained node.reopened, change.accepted, node.decided for x.

After `werk reopen a --reason rejected --why ...`, `werk stale` printed only 'stale    b  Card B / from #a, rejected, <day>' and no C (C's show header has no stale/paused mark). The stale-list entry for B does not name the depends_on link; only `werk show b` prints 'b -> a depends_on: b uses a' in its trace. Product gap in the stale list, I think, not a binder error.

After reopen a --reason postponed, show headers of b, c, d said 'paused', d still '[decided]'; `werk stale` listed 'paused   d  Card D / from #a, postponed, <day>, via #b, #c'; no card or line was stale.

C depends on A and refines B. After reopen A postponed and reopen B rejected, show c header was 'card c  [decided]  stale' (no paused); `werk stale` printed 'stale    c  Card C / from #b, rejected, <day>'.

After reopen a --reason rejected, `werk stale` listed b and c as stale, but `werk rederive b --confirm a` exited 1: 'refused: #b cannot be confirmed: basis: #a is open / werk status a decided', so b stays stale. A probe showed the step works only if A is decided again first, which the step does not say.
After reopen a --reason postponed, b and c showed 'paused'; `werk status a decided` cleared both marks, `werk stale` printed 'nothing is marked', and c still showed '[decided]'.

Ran `werk remove cache --actor you` (remove needs --actor you). show cache/eviction exited 1 with '#cache is removed...' / '#eviction is removed with #cache...'; show storage refines rows held index but not cache/eviction; `werk removed` printed 'cache: removed / and eviction'; the log kept its old lines plus exactly one new one.

After remove and `werk restore cache --actor you`, show cache exited 0 with no 'removed', '<- refines eviction', '-> depends_on      memory  Memory budget'; show storage listed cache again; `werk removed` no longer named cache.
`werk remove bad --reparent --actor you`: show bad said '#bad is removed'; show storage refines rows held write and read; show write/read exited 0 with 'parent: storage  Storage' and no 'removed'.

Backup depends on a card reopened postponed, Quota on a card reopened rejected (seeded node.reopened). `werk find storage` printed only 'cache  open  Cache' and 'index  open  Index'; no backup, quota or outside card.
After `werk remove cache --actor you`, `werk find storage` listed index and not cache; after `werk restore cache --actor you` it listed both cache and index.
